### The problem I am using the UniFI G4 Doorbell + Dream Machine Pro. Since December the doorbell automation I have set for this doorbell stopped working. When I check the sensor for it in home assistant it doesn't detect that the button is pressed anymore. I have enabled the last doorbell ring sensor to see if presses do get detected and this does provide data for when the doorbell last was pressed. I have already tried the following: - Reload the integration - Reset both Unifi Protect and Network in HA - Re-adopt the doorbell (and factory resetting it) Diagnostics were recorded as follows: turned on debug logging, pressed doorbell, waited 15 seconds, exported logs ### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue? core-2023.12.4 ### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core? core-2022.12.0 ### What type of installation are you running? Home Assistant Container ### Integration causing the issue unifiprotect ### Link to integration documentation on our website https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/unifiprotect/ ### Diagnostics information [home-assistant_unifiprotect_2023-12-31T15-36-32.602Z.log](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/13802159/home-assistant_unifiprotect_2023-12-31T15-36-32.602Z.log) ### Example YAML browser, so all I can provide for now is the debug logs: ```html 500 Internal Server Error

500 Internal Server Error

Server got itself in trouble ``` Here are the access control settings for the local account I'm using for HA and Scrypted: ![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/803255/fb5d5953-434b-4715-b481-59d7df074325) The doorbell action _does_ trigger on Scrypted providing us homekit notifications Timeline view: ![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/803255/3a2b61f2-771a-4970-b749-1ba87dacbc8e) Before 16:23 I was factory resetting and re-adopting the doorbell hence the blank space. Some extra notes that have an impact on this issue: - I recently migrated from a Raspberry Pi 2 to an x86_64 system while preserving the configuration. - I created a new local user account with the above mentioned access controls which are both in use by HA and Scrypted to access the Protect API and deleted the original (known working for the sensor) one in the UniFi console - The last known working core version that I had tried out was unfortunately: core-2022.12.0. However, running that again on the old pi with the new account credentials gives no success either.
items.title: UniFi Protect - G4 Doorbell binary sensor does not trigger since Protect 2.10.11
